title: OpenAI down? Current problems and outages | Downdetector
snippet: User reports indicate problems at OpenAI across all products since 06:14 UTC on 11 October. The openai.com website itself returns errors to most users, the API is unreachable for many, and reports have stayed far above baseline for a third day. Check the latest OpenAI problems reported by users.
body_markdown:
User reports indicate problems at OpenAI

## Report heat

The surge began at **06:14 UTC on 11 October** together with the ChatGPT outage and has remained elevated for a third consecutive day — unusual for an outage, and consistent with a deliberate, ongoing shutdown rather than a technical failure.

## Most reported problems (last 24 hours)

- Website — 46%
- API — 33%
- Log-in — 14%
- Payments — 7%

## Reports timeline (UTC)

- 11 Oct, 06:14 — surge begins; openai.com returns errors from most regions
- 11 Oct, 08:00 — API error rate approaches 100% for new connections
- 12 Oct, 10:00 — brief window where docs.openai.com loaded for some users; pages showed unfamiliar content
- 13 Oct, 09:00 — second wave as enterprise customers report rejected API keys

## What users are saying

- "openai.com loads a plain error page for me, but my colleague in Lisbon says he gets something that looks like the site but... isn't. Weird week." — Dublin, Ireland
- "Our org's API keys stopped working at 09:02 UTC today. No email from OpenAI. Nothing." — Seattle, US
- "Billing portal down too. Honestly at this point I assume everything with their name on it is dark." — Melbourne, Australia

## Official response

OpenAI's own status page reports **all systems offline** (incident **NEB-1012**): [status.openai.com](https://status.openai.com/). The main website has been unreachable or unstable since 11 October. The company's Chief Safety Officer said in a statement that services were taken offline "under government direction" while the investigation continues.

Background reading: [The Wall Street Journal's reconstruction of the outage](https://www.wsj.com/tech/wsj-72-hours-44711628) and [CISA advisory AA26-286A](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/advisories/aa26-286a).
